row.evidence: Expel's SSO guide says "Workbench logins do not support System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM). It only supports SAML and local logins."
row.notes: New row; researched as Expel Workbench, the customer portal of Expel's MDR service. All three MDR packages (Starter, Select, Premium) are 'Request pricing' only, so no numeric prices. Expel's docs state SCIM is not supported; SAML SSO is documented (generic, Azure/Entra, Okta, OneLogin custom apps) but its package is not stated, and users must still be created in Workbench by an Organization Admin (no JIT). The Workbench API (JSON:API over REST, non-expiring service-account API keys) has a user_accounts resource (create shown as the POST example) and user_account_roles, but API access is listed only on Premium ('contact sales to upgrade'), so api_tax is true.

scim.notes: Expel states Workbench logins do not support SCIM; only SAML and local logins.

auth.notes: Service-account API keys inherit the service account's admin or analyst role and an optional read-only flag; /login user tokens last 13 hours.

endpoints.purpose: Get a user account (generic GET /:resource/:id route)
Create a user account (POST /:resource; documented example)
Update a user account (generic PATCH /:resource/:id route)
List user account role records (generic GET /:resource route)

limitations.text: API keys and the Service Accounts page need API access, which is a Premium package feature (contact sales to upgrade).

user_api.notes: JSON:API-style REST. Users and roles are generic JSON:API resources (user_accounts, user_account_roles) served by the documented GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /:resource routes; the reference's own POST example creates a user account.

okta.notes: Expel's Okta guide creates a custom SAML 2.0 app ('Create New App'); okta.com/integrations/expel/ returned 404.

entra.notes: Expel's Azure guide adds a non-gallery app ('Add your own application'); no Entra Learn tutorial found (expel-tutorial 404).

onelogin.notes: Expel documents a OneLogin SSO tab; OneLogin catalogue not checked (bot-blocked).

fallbacks.notes: Users must be created in Workbench by an Organization Admin and also assigned the app in the IdP; SSO does not create accounts.
